versions.changelog:
unison-chief-complaint-disease-op v1.0.1

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Updated default model name in documentation from u1-insuremed to u2-med.
- No functional changes to code or main logic; documentation and dependency references only.

med-emr-qc-chief-complaint-disease-op v1.0.0

- Initial release supporting outpatient medical quality control for: "Chief complaint should not include diseases and operations".
- Provides script-based command-line tool to analyze and validate medical record files in multiple formats (txt, pdf, doc, excel, etc).
- Integrates with HiVoice MaaS medical LLM via API, returning result as "无缺陷" or "有缺陷" with explanation.
- Ensures data privacy: requires de-identified text, never stores input or results, and is for quality control only—not medical advice.
- Self-contained implementation; no third-party dependencies needed for core use (standard library only).
